name: ChatGPT Ads
desc: Sponsored placements inside ChatGPT answers, bought through Ads Manager.
desc_zh: 出现在 ChatGPT 回答里的赞助内容，通过 Ads Manager 投放。
solves: Free access to a frontier model needs a revenue line that does not touch the answers. Ads sit clearly labelled below the response and never change what ChatGPT says.
solves_zh: 免费使用前沿模型需要一条不碰答案的收入线。广告清楚标注在回答下方，并且绝不改变 ChatGPT 给出的内容。
best_for: You want to reach people while they are comparing options in a conversation.
best_for_zh: 你想在用户对话里比较选项时触达他们。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — ChatGPT release notes and OpenAI news）。 First public availability 2026-02-09 (US test), which is before the discovery window, but it is absent from the ledger partition list so it is proposed under rule (b). openai.com/ads/ returns 403 to automated fetches and redirects to ads.openai.com. 89 countries as of 2026-10-21. 首次公开日期来源：https://openai.com/index/testing-ads-in-chatgpt 官网未直接确认（403）。
